decision: Reframe REQ-04 per-message rating as per-decision (confidence entries) + per-step-outcome signals — Luca has no message loop
alternatives: literal per-message rating (no message loop exists)
reasoning: Luca is an autonomous pipeline with no chat-message turns; faithful adaptation maps -message- to -decision-/-step-outcome- so full-auto runs are never signal-empty
risk: If user wanted literal interactive per-turn rating, the reframe ships the wrong granularity and REQ-04 misses intent

task: capture surface: telemetry-emit-only vs new CLI verb
decision: Emit new telemetry kinds (signal.satisfaction, signal.failure-dump, classifier.override) via existing luca telemetry emit — NO new CLI verb
reasoning: telemetry emit is in LUCA_TOPLEVEL_READ so always-available in every phase; open kind union needs no schema change; new verb hits the 3-registry trap
risk: Free-form meta is less discoverable than a typed verb; mistyped kind strings silently land as unknown kinds

task: failure-dump home: meta inline vs dumpRef to .luca/tmp
decision: Small dumps go in meta directly; large dumps write .luca/tmp/<kebab>.json and reference via meta.dumpRef
alternatives: new phase-artifact contract entry for dumps
reasoning: .luca/tmp is gitignored ephemeral CLI-handoff dir, avoids a new LUCA_DIR_CONTRACT entry; keeps single telemetry line under PIPE_BUF
risk: dumpRef files are ephemeral/gitignored so dumps are not durable across cleanup
